title: Platform Engineer: Build Internal Developer Platforms
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Platform Engineer: Build internal developer platforms with golden paths, self-service infrastructure, CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability, and developer experience. This roadmap progresses from foundational concepts to advanced platform architecture and operations, emphasizing hands-on project experience.

tree.name: Foundations: Role, Principles & Essential Tools
tree.description: Establish a strong understanding of the Platform Engineer role, its core principles, and the foundational technical skills required to build and operate internal developer platforms.

resources.title: What is Platform Engineering? Principles and Practices
The Rise of Platform Engineering - A Definitive Guide

children.name: Understanding the Role & Principles
children.description: Explore the definition, benefits, and core philosophies of Platform Engineering, differentiating it from DevOps and SRE, and understanding its impact on developer experience.

resources.title: Platform as a Product: The What, Why, and How

children.name: Operating Systems, Shell Scripting & Networking Fundamentals
children.description: Master Linux/Unix operating system concepts, essential shell scripting (Bash, Zsh) for automation, command-line tools, and fundamental networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP) critical for platform interaction and troubleshooting.

children.name: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
children.description: Understand core cloud computing concepts (elasticity, scalability, high availability), service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), deployment models, and the basic architecture of major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including common services like Compute, Storage, Networking, and IAM.

children.name: Version Control with Git & Collaboration
children.description: Master Git for version control, including branching strategies, merging, rebasing, and collaborating effectively using platforms like GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.

tree.name: Infrastructure as Code & Containerization
tree.description: Master the art of declarative infrastructure management and containerization, forming the bedrock for building scalable, reproducible, and immutable platforms.

resources.title: Infrastructure as Code: From Fundamentals to Practices

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform
children.description: Learn to provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform, including HCL syntax, state management, modules, providers, remote backends, and advanced patterns for managing complex environments.

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Deep dive into Docker concepts such as images, containers, registries, Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, container networking, volumes, and basic container orchestration with Docker Compose.

children.name: Configuration Management & Immutable Infrastructure
children.description: Understand how to automate software provisioning and configuration management using tools like Ansible, focusing on idempotency, playbooks, and roles. Explore the benefits of immutable infrastructure and tools like Packer for building golden images.

tree.name: Kubernetes Ecosystem Mastery
tree.description: Gain in-depth expertise in Kubernetes, from core concepts and operational management to advanced patterns and security, which is critical for modern cloud-native platforms.

children.name: Kubernetes Core Concepts & Architecture
children.description: Learn the fundamental architecture of Kubernetes, including control plane components (API Server, etcd, Scheduler, Controller Manager), worker nodes, and key resources like Pods, Deployments, Services, StatefulSets, and Namespaces.

children.name: Kubernetes Operations & Management
children.description: Master `kubectl` for interacting with clusters, manage application deployments with Helm, and understand how to manage configuration (ConfigMaps, Secrets) and storage (PVs, PVCs, StorageClasses) in Kubernetes. Learn about rolling updates and rollbacks.

children.name: Kubernetes Networking & Storage Deep Dive
children.description: Deep dive into Kubernetes networking models (CNI, Service discovery, Ingress, Egress), understand Load Balancers, and explore various storage options, including persistent volumes, storage classes, volume provisioners, and CSI drivers.

children.name: Kubernetes Security & Access Management
children.description: Implement robust security practices within Kubernetes, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Pod Security Standards/Admission Controllers, Network Policies, secrets management strategies, and image security best practices for cluster hardening.

children.name: Advanced Kubernetes Patterns & Extensibility
children.description: Explore advanced Kubernetes features like Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs), Operators, Admission Controllers, and gain an introduction to Service Meshes (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) for traffic management, policy enforcement, and observability.

children.name: Advanced Kubernetes Deployment & Configuration
children.description: Deepen skills in managing complex Kubernetes deployments using advanced templating and packaging tools like Kustomize for overlays and `ytt` or `jsonnet` for programmable configuration. Explore best practices for application packaging and environment separation.

tree.name: CI/CD, GitOps & Automation
tree.description: Build robust, automated CI/CD pipelines and implement GitOps principles to manage deployments and infrastructure declaratively, ensuring consistent, secure, and reliable delivery.

resources.title: CI/CD Best Practices for Cloud-Native Applications

children.name: CI/CD Pipeline Design & Implementation
children.description: Design and implement continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines using popular tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Tekton, focusing on Pipeline as Code, automated testing, and release strategies.

children.name: GitOps Principles & Tools (ArgoCD/Flux)
children.description: Understand GitOps philosophy, declarative infrastructure, and implement GitOps workflows for Kubernetes using tools like ArgoCD or Flux CD for automated, auditable, and traceable deployments.

children.name: Scripting & Automation for Platform Engineers
children.description: Develop proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Go for automating operational tasks, developing custom tools, interacting with APIs, and building command-line utilities for platform management and developer workflows.

tree.name: Observability & Monitoring Strategy
tree.description: Implement comprehensive observability solutions to gain deep insights into platform and application health, performance, and behavior, using metrics, logs, and traces. Focus on proactive identification and resolution of issues.

resources.title: Observability vs. Monitoring: What's the Difference?
The Three Pillars of Observability: Metrics, Logs, and Traces

children.name: Fundamentals of Observability & SRE Metrics
children.description: Understand the core concepts of metrics, logs, and traces, and how they contribute to a holistic view of system health and performance. Learn about Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles like SLOs (Service Level Objectives), SLIs (Service Level Indicators), and Error Budgets.

children.name: Metrics & Alerting with Prometheus & Grafana
children.description: Implement metric collection using Prometheus, configure Alertmanager for intelligent and actionable notifications, and create insightful dashboards with Grafana for visualization, trend analysis, and real-time monitoring of platform components.

children.name: Centralized Logging & Distributed Tracing
children.description: Set up centralized logging solutions (e.g., Loki, Fluentd/Fluent Bit, ELK Stack/OpenSearch, Splunk) for efficient log aggregation and analysis. Implement distributed tracing (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin, OpenTelemetry) to diagnose issues across complex microservices architectures.

tree.name: Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Design & Build
tree.description: Learn to design, build, and evolve Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) that provide golden paths, self-service capabilities, and significantly enhance developer experience, driving efficiency and innovation.

resources.title: Backstage: The Open Platform for Frontend Infrastructure
Internal Developer Platform: A New Paradigm

children.name: IDP Concepts & Developer Experience
children.description: Understand the principles of Golden Paths, self-service portals, and how to measure and improve developer experience (DevEx) through platform design. Explore concepts like cognitive load and inner-sourcing.

resources.title: Golden Path to Greatness - Charity Majors

children.name: Building with Backstage & Crossplane
children.description: Implement IDPs using Backstage for service catalog, software templates, and documentation portals. Extend Kubernetes with Crossplane to manage and provision external cloud resources from a unified control plane.

children.name: Platform APIs & Gateway Management
children.description: Design and implement internal platform APIs for programmatic self-service capabilities, enabling automation and integration. Manage external and internal traffic with API Gateways (e.g., NGINX Ingress, Kong, Istio Gateway) for routing, security, and rate limiting.

children.name: Platform as a Product Lifecycle & Feedback
children.description: Apply product management principles to the IDP, focusing on user research, defining platform roadmap, gathering feedback from developers, and iterating on platform services to drive adoption and satisfaction. Understand key platform metrics like DORA metrics and developer satisfaction.

resources.title: DORA Metrics: What They Are & How to Measure Them

tree.name: Platform Security & Reliability Engineering
tree.description: Focus on hardening platform security, implementing governance, and applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to ensure high availability, resilience, operational excellence, and a secure software supply chain.

children.name: Platform Security, Governance & Supply Chain
children.description: Implement security best practices for platform components, manage secrets securely (Vault), enforce policies with Policy-as-Code (OPA Gatekeeper), and secure the software supply chain through image scanning, signature verification, and compliance automation.

children.name: SRE Practices & Platform Reliability
children.description: Apply SRE principles like error budgets, blameless post-mortems, and toil reduction. Design for resilience with patterns like circuit breakers, retries, and rate limiting. Develop strategies for disaster recovery, backups, and high availability.

resources.title: Implementing SLIs, SLOs, and Error Budgets

children.name: Incident Management & Resiliency Engineering
children.description: Develop effective incident response strategies, create comprehensive runbooks, perform post-incident reviews, and practice chaos engineering to proactively identify and mitigate system weaknesses and improve operational robustness.

tree.name: Capstone Project & Career Readiness
tree.description: Consolidate all learned skills into a comprehensive capstone project that showcases your ability to design, build, and operate a full-featured internal developer platform, and prepare for career advancement.

resources.title: Building a Robust Portfolio for Platform Engineers

children.name: Capstone Project: Build a Golden Path IDP
children.description: Design and implement a complete Internal Developer Platform, including IaC for infrastructure, a Backstage instance with custom templates, CI/CD pipelines, integrated observability, and secure deployments. Document architecture and operational procedures.

resources.title: Example: Building an IDP with Backstage, Kubernetes, and Terraform
Cloud Native Buildpacks for Reproducible Builds

children.name: Technical Documentation & Communication
children.description: Develop strong technical writing skills for documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams (e.g., C4 Model), and incident reports. Practice presenting complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

resources.title: The Art of Documentation - A Developer's Guide

children.name: Career Readiness & Interview Preparation
children.description: Refine your resume, create impactful case studies from your projects, prepare for technical interviews (system design, troubleshooting, coding challenges), behavioral questions, and effectively network within the platform engineering community.

resources.title: Behavioral Interview Strategies for Tech Roles
